disclaimer: Illustrative investigative check shipped with the prototype. It is not derived from any verified or suppressed incident, and a match is not evidence of fraud. Set thresholds from your own policy before use.
name: Required procurement documents missing
description: Flags purchase orders at or above a configured value whose supplied document list lacks any of the configured required documents.

documentThreshold.rationale: Illustrative placeholder above which quotes and an approval form are expected. Replace with your policy value.

applicability.description: The order value is at or above the document threshold

support.assumption: Document requirements usually scale with value.

conditions.description: At least one required document is absent from the supplied list

support.assumption: Quote and approval form are example requirements, not a universal standard.

benignExplanations: Documents stored in a system not included in the import
falsePositiveConsiderations: Document names vary between systems; map them consistently on import
